title: What Is a Mobile Camp?
excerpt: Mobile camps follow the migration and move several times a year. What to expect in terms of comfort and location.
body:
A mobile camp is a tented camp that moves a few times a year, usually following the Great Migration.

## Why mobile

The herds move across the Serengeti. A mobile camp moves with them, so you sleep close to the action.

## Comfort

Despite the name, mobile camps can be very comfortable: real beds, bucket showers with hot water, flush or eco toilets and good food.

## Location

Camps move to the south (Ndutu) for the calving season and to the north for the river crossings.

## Atmosphere

Small, intimate and close to nature.

## Who it suits

Travellers who want to be close to the migration and enjoy the bush.

See [where to stay for the migration](/blog/migration-camps-where-to-stay/) or [plan your safari](/travel-proposal/).
